summary: You can now give people and groups access straight from the Access map.

new.title: Grant access from the Access map
new.text: Select a person, a group or a permission group and add people, groups or permissions to it. Nothing reaches your tenant until you commit on Review & Save.

new.title: The map only adds
new.text: Nothing can be removed from the Access map, so it stays safe to show a reviewer. Linking needs the Admin role; removing access stays on Maintenance & Revoke.

fixes.title: Direct role assignments are kept
fixes.text: Saving the table of directly assigned roles can no longer drop rows.
